Definition: of foreign origin (compare H4074); a Median, or inhabitant of Media:--Mede.
BiblicalUsage: A Mede is a man of Media, and the word appears once, at Pentecost. Medes are named among the nations who heard the apostles speak in their own tongues the wonderful works of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Mede at Pentecost is the sign of the gospel's reach: a man from the old empire of the east hears the gospel in his own tongue, and the nations God once scattered are gathered again.
